name: stabilizer clifford compose
task_prompt:
Return the qiskit.quantum_info Clifford obtained by composing two Hadamards on qubit 0 of a 1-qubit CliffordTableau, i.e. the identity Clifford, and report its effective single-qubit matrix via to_matrix().
You must implement this using a function named `clifford_double_h` taking no arguments.
